cases.label: 현재 주소의 유효한 ID를 실제 DOM에 복원한다
잘못되거나 중복된 query를 replace하며 소유하지 않은 값을 보존한다
cases.probe: const root=document.getElementById(context.rootId);const originalURL=location.href;const originalState=history.state;let router;try{const initial=new URL(location.href);initial.search="?lesson=invalid&lesson=b&keep=yes";initial.hash='notes';history.replaceState({kept:'state'},'',initial);const before=history.length;router=submission.createLessonRouter(root,['a','b'],'a');const url=new URL(location.href);observe({ids:url.searchParams.getAll('lesson'),keep:url.searchParams.get('keep'),hash:url.hash,historyDelta:history.length-before,historyState:history.state});}finally{router?.dispose();history.replaceState(originalState,'',originalURL);root.replaceChildren();}

cases.label: 탐색 즉시 렌더링하고 같은 ID의 History 항목은 중복하지 않는다
cases.probe: const root=document.getElementById(context.rootId);const originalURL=location.href;const originalState=history.state;let router;try{const initial=new URL(location.href);initial.search="?lesson=a&keep=yes";initial.hash='notes';history.replaceState({kept:'state'},'',initial);router=submission.createLessonRouter(root,['a','b'],'a');const originalPush=history.pushState;let pushCalls=0;history.pushState=function(...args){pushCalls++;return Reflect.apply(originalPush,this,args);};try{const first=router.navigate('b');const second=router.navigate('b');const url=new URL(location.href);observe({first,second,pushCalls,lesson:url.searchParams.get('lesson'),keep:url.searchParams.get('keep'),text:root.querySelector('output').textContent});}finally{history.pushState=originalPush;}}finally{router?.dispose();history.replaceState(originalState,'',originalURL);root.replaceChildren();}

cases.label: 실제 History.back 후 URL·화면·강의별 초안이 함께 복원된다
cases.probe: const root=document.getElementById(context.rootId);const originalURL=location.href;const originalState=history.state;let router;try{const initial=new URL(location.href);initial.search="?lesson=a";initial.hash='notes';history.replaceState({kept:'state'},'',initial);router=submission.createLessonRouter(root,['a','b','c'],'a');const input=root.querySelector('textarea');input.value='a 초안';input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));router.navigate('b');input.value='b 초안';input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));router.navigate('c');await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const onPop=()=>{clearTimeout(timer);window.removeEventListener('popstate',onPop);resolve();};const timer=setTimeout(()=>{window.removeEventListener('popstate',onPop);reject(new Error('History traversal timed out'));},1500);window.addEventListener('popstate',onPop);history.back();});const b={state:router.getState(),input:input.value};await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const onPop=()=>{clearTimeout(timer);window.removeEventListener('popstate',onPop);resolve();};const timer=setTimeout(()=>{window.removeEventListener('popstate',onPop);reject(new Error('History traversal timed out'));},1500);window.addEventListener('popstate',onPop);history.back();});observe({b,a:{state:router.getState(),input:input.value},url:new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('lesson')});}finally{router?.dispose();history.replaceState(originalState,'',originalURL);root.replaceChildren();}

cases.label: 한글·구분자가 있는 ID를 roundtrip하고 잘못된 이동은 거부한다
cases.probe: const root=document.getElementById(context.rootId);const originalURL=location.href;const originalState=history.state;let router;try{const initial=new URL(location.href);initial.search="?lesson=a&keep=yes";initial.hash='notes';history.replaceState({kept:'state'},'',initial);router=submission.createLessonRouter(root,['a','한글 & 기초'],'a');router.navigate('한글 & 기초');let errorName='accepted';try{router.navigate('unknown');}catch(error){errorName=error.name;}observe({id:new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('lesson'),keep:new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('keep'),state:router.getState(),errorName});}finally{router?.dispose();history.replaceState(originalState,'',originalURL);root.replaceChildren();}

cases.label: 새 인스턴스는 URL 선택만 복원하고 영속 저장을 가장하지 않는다
cases.probe: const root=document.getElementById(context.rootId);const originalURL=location.href;const originalState=history.state;let router;try{const initial=new URL(location.href);initial.search="?lesson=b";initial.hash='notes';history.replaceState({kept:'state'},'',initial);router=submission.createLessonRouter(root,['a','b'],'a');const input=root.querySelector('textarea');input.value='인스턴스 초안';input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));const previous=router.getState();router.dispose();router=submission.createLessonRouter(root,['a','b'],'a');observe({previous,current:router.getState()});}finally{router?.dispose();history.replaceState(originalState,'',originalURL);root.replaceChildren();}

cases.label: 해제한 인스턴스는 실제 popstate와 입력을 더 이상 반영하지 않는다
cases.probe: const root=document.getElementById(context.rootId);const originalURL=location.href;const originalState=history.state;let router;try{const initial=new URL(location.href);initial.search="?lesson=a";initial.hash='notes';history.replaceState({kept:'state'},'',initial);router=submission.createLessonRouter(root,['a','b'],'a');router.navigate('b');router.dispose();router.dispose();const input=root.querySelector('textarea');input.value='해제 후 입력';input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const onPop=()=>{clearTimeout(timer);window.removeEventListener('popstate',onPop);resolve();};const timer=setTimeout(()=>{window.removeEventListener('popstate',onPop);reject(new Error('History traversal timed out'));},1500);window.addEventListener('popstate',onPop);history.back();});let errorName='accepted';try{router.navigate('a');}catch(error){errorName=error.name;}observe({state:router.getState(),text:root.querySelector('output').textContent,url:new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('lesson'),errorName});}finally{router?.dispose();history.replaceState(originalState,'',originalURL);root.replaceChildren();}
